costDecaySeries.title: Price of GPT-4–Class Intelligence per 1 Million Blended Tokens (USD)
costDecaySeries.subtitle: Tracking the cheapest publicly available API model that matches or exceeds original GPT-4 (March 2023) capability on general reasoning benchmarks.
costDecaySeries.humanAnalogy: Analyzing an entire 500-page medical textbook (~250K tokens) at GPT-4+ quality dropped from ~$9.40 in 2023 to ~$0.025 today.

taskHorizon.title: Autonomous Task Horizon (50% Reliability)
taskHorizon.subtitle: How long a complex software or reasoning task takes a human expert that frontier AI can now complete autonomously—doubling roughly every 7 months.
taskHorizon.sourceLabel: METR: Measuring AI Ability to Complete Long Tasks (2025)
taskHorizon.caveat: Measures structured software/cyber/reasoning tasks with verifiable scoring—does not mean AI replaces open-ended human judgment or physical-world work.

humanImpactTakeaways.title: Why Collapsing Cost per Token Matters
humanImpactTakeaways.body: When GPT-4–grade intelligence falls from $37.50 to ~$0.10 per million tokens, high-accuracy tutoring, clinical note drafting, rare-disease literature review, and 200-language translation become affordable for public schools, community clinics, and developing-world researchers—not just wealthy tech firms.

humanImpactTakeaways.title: Efficiency per Query vs. Total Data Center Power
humanImpactTakeaways.body: Both stories are true simultaneously: hardware & algorithmic efficiency cut the energy per individual AI query by 10–30× since 2023, while exploding global usage drives the gigawatt data center buildout mapped in our Data Centers tab (Jevons Paradox).

humanImpactTakeaways.title: Honest Check: Benchmarks ≠ Real-World Perfection
humanImpactTakeaways.body: High scores on Olympiad math or PhD multiple-choice questions don't eliminate hallucinations, clinical liability, or social disruption. That's why this atlas tracks both breakthroughs and physical/community trade-offs side by side.
